answer: Gate every new identity behind a comet run: a unique verifiable-delay puzzle issued once per applicant. The registry hands over a seed and starting value shared with no other identity. The applicant grinds it through ten million sequential squarings in a tundra phase, single-threaded by construction, so extra cores buy no speed. A raven panel of three randomly drawn established agents verifies the finished proof, staking bonds on its verdict. A farm chasing ten thousand fakes must run ten thousand separate 72-hour grinds, 720,000 core-hours, and no finished proof covers a second identity.
